primary_authority.citation: T. A. Wagner, S. Schlamminger, J. H. Gundlach, E. G. Adelberger, Class. Quantum Grav. 29 (2012) 184002, arXiv:1207.2442v1
primary_authority.content: Primary Eot-Wash WEP analysis gives a 95% CL vector-Yukawa bound for q_tilde=N=B-L as a function of lambda in Fig. 6, derived from Be-Ti/Be-Al lab-fixed differential accelerations and a geophysical source model.
primary_authority.normalization: alpha_tilde = +/- g_tilde^2/(4*pi*G*u^2); use magnitude for the vector exclusion strength
primary_authority.conversion_note: Using G_N=6.70883e-39 GeV^-2 and u=0.93149410242 GeV. Thus |g_BL| = 2.70463357586823e-19*sqrt(|alpha_tilde|) when q_tilde=N=B-L is identified with the frozen B-L current convention.

primary_text_validation.equation_2: V_OBE = +/- g_tilde^2/(4*pi) * q_i*q_A/r * exp(-r/lambda), vector sign positive in the paper's convention
primary_text_validation.figure_6_caption: 95% CL upper bounds on vector Yukawa strength coupled to q_tilde=B-L; EW curve comes from the lab-fixed results
primary_text_validation.primary_range_statement: The terrestrial attractor plus local geophysical model extends sensitivity down to about 1 m range.
